heroHeadline: Trump Claims Russia-Ukraine Energy Strike Truce as Russian Guided Bomb Wounds Infant in Izium
heroSubtitle: President Trump said on September 14 that Ukraine and Russia had agreed to halt strikes on each other's energy infrastructure, but Zelensky called the claim conditional on a 'genuine' Russian commitment and a Ukrainian energy official said Kyiv had no formal notification of a deal; the Kremlin's Peskov called it a one-sided ask on Ukraine's energy 'Achilles' heel.' The diplomacy came as Russia struck Izium in Kharkiv Oblast with a guided aerial bomb, injuring three people including a 2-month-old infant and destroying four homes, while NATO's Rutte and Poland's Tusk pledged more support for Ukraine following the September 13 drone strike on a Kyiv-Warsaw train near the Polish border. Russian military losses reached ~1,508,600 since 2022 per the Ukrainian General Staff, an increase of ~1,700 in the latest 24 hours.
